answer: Bind each identity to one verified volunteer shift: a food bank coordinator signs off the hours, and the network stores only the shift hash, so one person yields one identity. A sybil farmer faces timber-hard cost — every fake needs a real human standing a real shift, not a script. One honest thread of service, a violet stamp of proof per person, ties each identity to a body in a room. Limit: it excludes people far from charities, and coordinators can be bribed, so it must gate rewards, not entry.
